**What to add or correct**
<!-- e.g. "Add sorghum shoot fly threshold", "Chickpea stage bands are wrong" -->

**File**
- [ ] `crops.json` (stages)  - [ ] `problems.json` (diseases, pests)
- [ ] `thresholds.json` (ETL + stage factors)  - [ ] `ipm.json` (ladders)
- [ ] `label_claims.json` (CIB&RC claims, PHI, toxicity)

**Source — REQUIRED**
<!-- ICAR institute, State Agricultural University package of practices, CIB&RC
     label, or a published advisory. A row without a citation cannot be merged:
     a farmer cannot audit it and neither can a judge. -->

**Verified or draft?**
<!-- `status: draft` is honest and fine. Marking something verified that nobody
     verified is not. -->

**Does this change an existing recommendation?**
<!-- If yes, say what it was and what it becomes. Someone may already have
